data.title: Ask for a *quick answer*
data.subtitle: Usage tip 3 of 6. Not every question needs a file.

blocks.text: Tell Claude when you only need **a quick answer**, not a file or finished deliverable.

blocks.new: Quick answer only: no files, no web search. [your question]

blocks.text: A quick answer can still be wrong. **Check** anything high-stakes and the sources it cites.
